title: `UniswapV3Swapper` and `UniswapV2Swapper` will fail when depositing received ETH into YieldBox
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as it causes swap to fail  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it occurs when depositing WETH to YieldBox  ## Description  When `UniswapV3Swapper.swap()` is called with `depositToYb = true` and `tokenOut = address(0)` (WETH), it will swap the Input Token for WETH and then unwrap the WETH before depositing ETH into YieldBox.  However, `yieldBox.depositAsset()` is used to deposit the unwrapped ETH, which is incorrect and will revert as it does not support deposit of native asset.  ```Solidity         amountOut = _swap(             tokenOut,             params,
